## Parent ticket and stable task ID

Link the milestone in [roadmap #3](https://github.com/OptimumAF/LocalLore/issues/3). Keep the original Mxx.yy ID for a split task; propose a new stable ID for new work. Link both directions and make the parent task row point here so its checklist is not maintained twice.

## Problem and scope

## Dependencies and interface contracts

## Acceptance criteria and relevant milestone gate

- [ ] Define observable success, failure paths, and required checks.

## Claim and ownership

Date, contributor/agent, branch/worktree, owned paths, interface version, planned checks, and handoff location. Read existing claims first; release/reassign explicitly.

## Verification and handoff

Post progress and end-of-session comments with commands/results, environment/versions, PR/commit, limitations, blockers, and next task. Leave implementation pending until owner acceptance/merge. This ticket does not authorize a release, merge, access change, or expansion of the human assignment.
